description: Job description What if advertising could feel like a feature rather than an interruption? That's the challenge this role is built around — and if that question excites you, read on. We are looking for a curious, consumer-obsessed Junior Product Manager to help shape the advertising experience on mobile.de. You will be part of the product organisation with strong ties into our advertising business unit, working to build solutions that genuinely work for consumers while delivering real value for advertisers. We are looking for someone who believes that advertising, done right, can be a meaningful part of the product experience — relevant, well-timed, and worth a user's attention. This role sits at the intersection of a great consumer experience and a meaningful advertising business. You'll work closely with engineering, design, analytics, and our advertising business stakeholders — navigating that tension is what makes this role exciting. mobile.de is Germany’s largest vehicle marketplace, with more than 1.6 million listed cars, commercial vehicles, motorcycles, and e-bikes (annual average 2025). Both private customers and registered vehicle dealers use the platform and benefit from more than 140 million visits per month*. As a “one-stop shop,” mobile.de’s offering includes not only buying and selling, but also financing and leasing solutions. Founded in 1996, the company is a subsidiary of Adevinta, a global leader in online classified portals. Based in Berlin-Charlottenburg, we offer a dynamic environment where growth, learning, and collaboration are at the heart of everything we do. If you are driven by an eagerness to disrupt, have a passion for collaboration, and are excited about shaping the future of mobility, we would love to hear from you. Job requirements 2–4 years of product management experience, or equivalent experience in a closely related role (e.g. strategy, UX, business, or a technical role with strong product exposure). You have some familiarity with advertising — either from working in a consumer product with ad monetisation, from a role at an ad tech company, a publisher, or an agency. We value the combination, but if we had to choose: a strong product thinker with a genuine curiosity for advertising beats an advertising expert with no product grounding. Consumer-first mindset: you instinctively ask how a change affects the user before asking how it affects the business — and you hold both in mind at the same time. Genuinely excited about advertising as a product problem — not someone who tolerates it as the commercial reality of a free product, but someone who finds it intellectually interesting to make ads relevant, well-placed, and worth a user's attention. Outcome-oriented: you don't see a feature shipped as a success. You care about whether it actually moved the needle. Comfortable with data: you can read a dashboard, ask the right follow-up questions, and form a point of view — even without always having all the answers. A strong communicator who can manage multiple stakeholders with different priorities and speak both the language of product and the language of the advertising sales team. Curious and self-driven — you bring structure to ambiguity, form your own point of view, and are always looking to sharpen your craft, regardless of where you are in your career. Experience in marketplaces, e-commerce, or consumer internet products is a plus. We value diverse backgrounds — you don't need to tick every box. If you're energised by the challenge of making advertising feel like a feature rather than an interruption, and you want to grow as a product manager in one of Germany's leading digital marketplaces, we'd love to hear from you. Job responsibilities Support the definition and execution of the product roadmap for our advertising products, balancing consumer experience with revenue impact. Develop a deep understanding of our consumers and how advertising touchpoints fit into — or disrupt — their journey on mobile.de. Collaborate with data and analytics partners to track the right metrics, interpret results, and identify opportunities to improve both ad performance and consumer satisfaction. Run and evaluate A/B experiments to validate hypotheses and measure the real impact of changes — on consumers and on the business. Act as a bridge between the product organisation and the advertising business unit, communicating clearly with both sides and helping align priorities. Contribute to the day-to-day execution of cross-functional teams including engineers, designers, and business stakeholders. Identify friction points in the advertising experience through user research, data analysis, and competitive benchmarking, and turn them into actionable improvements. Grow your product craft through hands-on delivery, structured feedback, and close collaboration with more experienced PMs on the team. Job benefits Working at mobile.de comes with its perks! Enjoy the following benefits (some of many): Rewards: competitive base salary and participation in the company’s incentive programs. Plan for the Future: On top of the statutory retirement insurance, we offer a competitive company pension scheme. Team-Building: Regular team and company events offer the opportunity to network and learn from each other. Learning & Development: Keep growing with access to coaching, learning platforms and resources. Mobility: Stay mobile with a monthly transportation allowance. Enjoy working: Our well-equipped office supports focused work and teamwork – plus inviting social zones where colleagues can relax and connect. Flexible working: a hybrid approach with the option to work abroad for a set number of days per year. Wellbeing: confidential employee assistance and support services available to employees and their immediate families. Family support: enhanced parental leave and family-friendly policies to support all parents and careers. Meaningful Work: We are a diverse, international, highly skilled and passionate team committed to a world where people share more and waste less. Every day you will have the opportunity to make a huge difference for our users, customers as well as shape the future. Embracing AI: We’re at the forefront of integrating cutting-edge AI technologies into our operations. Being part of mobile.de you will work with and learn about AI tools, contributing to projects that leverage AI to enhance efficiency, improve customer experiences, and drive our mission forward. With an AI-first mindset, we foster a culture of continuous learning and experimentation, empowering our team to explore and apply AI in meaningful ways for the company and themselves. Connection and Inclusion: Our culture is the glue that holds us together. We believe in making meaningful connections and creating an inclusive atmosphere with lots of opportunities to connect both in your day to day work and through social team activities (online and offline). mobile.de is an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status.

description: Are you obsessed with turning complex technical problems into products customers love? Then look no further, and join us here at Hadrian as our newest Product Manager ! Who are we: We are Hadrian - an offensive cybersecurity startup. We are reshaping the future of cybersecurity through the power of agentic AI injected with the hacker’s perspective. Founded in August 2021, we've secured funding and the backing of ABN AMRO Ventures and Cherry Ventures, propelling us into a new era. Our goal is to provide companies with an autonomous Threat Exposure Management platform. At Hadrian, we view security through a hacker's eyes because, well, hackers understand hackers best. We continuously map the digital footprint of organizations, discover risks, and prioritize remediation for security teams to harden their external attack surfaces. Located in Amsterdam's buzzing Leidseplein and by London's famous Paddington Station and our most recent US HQ in the heart of New York City, our diverse team from 25+ countries is on a mission to shake things up in offensive security. Join us in making waves and securing over 700 businesses, and be at the forefront of automated offensive security. Your Role: As a Product Manager at Hadrian, you will shape the future of autonomous offensive security by translating complex technical challenges into products that deliver meaningful value to our customers. You will sit at the intersection of customers, hackers, engineers, and business stakeholders to identify opportunities, define product direction, and guide execution from discovery through delivery. You'll work closely with highly technical teams building capabilities that help security teams understand and reduce their external attack surface at unprecedented scale. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in ambiguity, makes sense of complex technical domains, and can confidently balance customer needs, business priorities, and engineering realities. If you enjoy solving difficult problems, making data-informed decisions, and building products that push the boundaries of cybersecurity and AI, we would love to hear from you. What you will do as a Product Manager at Hadrian: Lead product discovery, working closely with customers, hackers, engineers, data analysts and the sales, and customer success team to identify product opportunities. Translate customer problems and business objectives into clear product strategies, priorities, and actionable roadmaps. Drive product delivery by partnering with engineering and design teams to refine requirements, scope initiatives, and ship high-impact solutions. Establish strong feedback loops by defining success metrics, measuring outcomes, and continuously iterating based on customer and product insights. Balance short-term customer needs with long-term product vision Facilitate alignment across teams, ensuring stakeholders understand priorities, trade-offs, and delivery plans. Contribute to Hadrian's overall product strategy and help elevate product management practices across the organization. Take on a unique challenge. You'll help define how autonomous security products evolve in a world increasingly shaped by AI. You are fit for this job because you: Have 5-7 years of experience in Product Management, preferably within a B2B SaaS environment serving technical users. Have experience building products for developers, security practitioners, or other highly technical audiences. Are highly technical, curious and comfortable working closely with engineers, hackers, and data-driven teams. Use AI as a key enabler to accelerate workflows and improve decision-making while maintaining a strong focus on customer value. Have experience conducting qualitative and quantitative user research and turning insights into product decisions. Excel at working with cross-functional teams and bringing clarity to ambiguous situations and competing priorities. Demonstrate strong product judgement and can make informed decisions with imperfect information. Have a bias for action and can turn opportunities into outcomes in fast-moving environments. Communicate clearly and influence stakeholders across different disciplines and levels of the organization. Bonus points if you have: Experience in cybersecurity, offensive security, or security products. Experience working on AI-enabled products or data-intensive platforms. Familiarity with developer tooling, APIs, cloud infrastructure, or platform products. Experience scaling product practices within high-growth startups or scale-ups. A background in software engineering or other technical disciplines. Contributions to product communities, speaking engagements, or thought leadership initiatives. Benefits at Hadrian: Permanent contract Unlimited paid holiday Stock options package Mobile phone stipend Work-from-home budget Business travel card Swapfiets Referral bonuses Why you want to be part of Hadrian: Make the internet safer: We enable companies to protect their customers, employees, and other stakeholders from malicious hackers by providing real-time Exposure Management from the Hacker’s perspective Board a primed rocket ship: Hadrian is growing fast; the team is approaching 90 wonderful people, notable customers are signed, and significant funding is raised. Now is the time to join our high-growth journey Be part of a strong and dynamic culture: Our values define who we are as a group and serve as the cornerstones to guide us in building a product that our customers love. At Hadrian, we achieve this by championing a culture that takes ownership, succeeds together, increases velocity, and pursues growth Sounds like the role for you? Hit the apply button! Our customers are seeking a world-class and reliable digital security service. That is exactly what we are offering. Therefore, a background check will be part of the process.
